free_tier.stated: Free plan: 50 wallet credits per month (reset each calendar month), 500 agent runs per month, 3 agents
free_tier.notes: credits are consumed while sandbox environments run; the 1 CPU environment (1 vCPU, 1 GiB, no GPU) is listed at USD 0.3 per hour on the USD / Hour view and at 3 credits per hour on the Credits / Hour view of the same table, so one credit is USD 0.10 at that ratio; the page prints no credits-to-USD rate and no top-up pack price; the 50 monthly Free plan credits therefore cover about 16.7 hours of the 1 CPU environment

per_object_cap.stated: unverified: the pricing page states no disk size and no object cap for a sandbox

retention.stated: unverified: no page read states whether a sandbox disk survives a stop or a delete
retention.notes: a runtime launched with the Home Folder keeps contents across sandbox sessions: the User folder is mounted at /home/datalayer/{user-handle} in the sandbox, from home/users/{user-uid} on the shared filesystem, and deleting or replacing the sandbox does not delete it; a paused runtime takes a snapshot that keeps its state; the pricing page and the environments page give no retention period, and the Home Folder page gives no length for the trash retention window

egress.terms: not published: no egress allowance or overage price on https://datalayer.ai/pricing and https://datalayer.ai

interface_detail: runtimes are reached from JupyterLab, from VS Code and through the datalayer CLI; the CLI lists each environment with its credits per second and its resources
tooling: the datalayer CLI, installed with pip install datalayer-core; datalayer envs ls lists the environments with their credits per second and their resources, and JupyterLab and VS Code are the graphical routes to the same runtimes
chaining: a runtime is reached from JupyterLab, from VS Code or through the datalayer CLI, and the CLI signs in to the platform; a code sandbox starts from an environment image that fixes its CPU, memory and GPU

limits.value: Free plan: 500 agent runs per month, 3 agents and 50 included wallet credits per month, reset each calendar month

limits_note: sandbox environments listed: 1 CPU (priced), A100 GPU + 4 CPUs, T4 GPU + 2 CPUs and 7 CPUs (each marked Unavailable); no session cap, idle-reap or network policy is stated on the pricing page

identity_cost.detail: email: the sign-up form asks for a username, an email address, a first name, a last name, a password and a password confirmation, and carries no phone-number field and no card field; the sign-in page creates the account with an email address, and the address receives a confirmation mail

confidence_note: documented: the Free plan allowance (50 wallet credits and 500 runs per month, 3 agents), the 1 CPU sandbox rate (USD 0.3 per hour, 3 credits per hour) and the sign-up form's fields (username, email, first name, last name, password) are printed on datalayer.ai; one credit is USD 0.10 as the ratio of the two printed rates for the same environment, a rate the page itself does not print; no top-up pack price is published

binding_note: the monthly wallet-credit allowance runs out first: the Free plan's 50 credits reset at the start of each calendar month and the 1 CPU sandbox burns 3 credits per hour, about 16.7 hours a month, while the page states no request rate, pull count or per-object cap
